claim_text: Before adding an iron supplement, total elemental iron exposure from all current supplements and medicines should be reconciled; excess iron can cause gastrointestinal adverse effects and may be harmful, while therapeutic iron should be managed according to diagnosis and monitoring.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent duplicate or excessive iron supplementation.

population.age_range: All ages; upper limits and treatment indications differ.
population.sex_or_life_stage: Pregnancy and menstruation affect requirements but do not remove the need to count existing intake.
population.other_context: Distinguish elemental iron from the mass of the iron salt.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Elemental iron in multivitamins, prenatal products, standalone supplements and medicines.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Iron Health Professional Fact Sheet describes upper intake levels, adverse effects and clinical treatment context.
limitations: Upper limits do not replace clinician-directed treatment.
Iron deficiency and iron overload require laboratory assessment.
Do not infer elemental iron from compound weight.
